job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed qfd_lst_v-3d5ad2a4ftt (qfd_lst_v, RTL 3d5ad2a4f, snapshot of 1 drifted files): same RTL, outline 260.04x69.072, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:qwen-blocks

benches.name: link_stn_s0_exact
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_lst_v_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_lst_v_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/ls00 -P tb_qwen_die_link_stn.SHAPE=0 -P tb_qwen_die_link_stn.NEG=0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_link_stn.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_link_stn.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/ls00 | tee {RUN}/bench/ls00.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/ls00.log
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 3d5ad2a4f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_lst_v_m5/src]
